compiled_state.title: llm-review: large-diff Strategy F path returns non-JSON LLM output -> CI job cancelled, no findings recorded
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 21c8c077d4b830de2439e4e49f3bfbf451c7c5b4
* **PR:** https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/pull/345 (worktree-20260524-135547 -> main; epic 4047-3cb1-6cb4-46a1 finalize)
* **PR scale:** 99 files changed, +12,609 / -4,936 lines (~18,600-line diff)
* **CI workflow:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml` job `llm-review`
* **Reviewer dispatch:** `plugins/dso/scripts/llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh`
* **Strategy activated:** Strategy F (file-filter + chunked + aggregated review) — triggered because diff exceeds the region-split threshold
* **Failing agent:** `code-reviewer-deep-correctness` (primary model: `claude-opus-4-7`)
* **Failed CI run id:** 26415787344 (job 77762612379)

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker (CI tooling cannot complete LLM review on a real-world large PR)

#### Expected Behavior

Per the deep-tier CI review contract, the llm-review job should run all 3 deep-tier specialist sub-agents (correctness, verification, hygiene) and the arch synthesizer against the PR diff and write findings consumed by mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh. The Strategy F large-diff path is the documented mechanism for handling diffs that exceed the region-split threshold; it MUST either produce a parseable findings JSON or escalate explicitly so the PR is not silently un-reviewed.

#### Actual Behavior

The llm-review job activated Strategy F, dispatched code-reviewer-deep-correctness on claude-opus-4-7, received a 134,457-character response that was not valid JSON, exhausted the fallback chain, and was then cancelled. The PR was left with mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED on a missing llm-review SUCCESS status, with no findings recorded.

Verbatim from the CI log:

```
2026-05-25T19:34:11Z INFO: diff exceeds region-split threshold — activating Strategy F file-filter + chunked + aggregated review
2026-05-25T19:34:11Z WARNING: review.large_diff.ignore.glob empty; consider defaults
2026-05-25T19:53:35Z ERROR: LLM returned non-JSON response (length=134457); cannot parse as findings.
2026-05-25T19:53:35Z ERROR: LLM returned non-JSON response (length=134457); cannot parse as findings.
2026-05-25T19:53:35Z Fallback chain exhausted for agent code-reviewer-deep-correctness (primary=claude-opus-4-7): LLM returned non-JSON response (length=134457); cannot parse as findings.
2026-05-25T20:18:56Z ##[error]The operation was canceled.
```

Time-on-failure: ~19 min 24 sec between Strategy F activation and the non-JSON parse error. The job ran another ~25 min before cancellation.

### 3. Action History and Workarounds

* **Steps taken:** 5 consecutive CI runs against PR #345 — every run shows llm-review cancelled.
* **Workaround used to unblock the PR:** Local deep-tier review dispatched manually from the orchestrator session against the same diff. Three specialist sub-agents (correctness, verification, hygiene-design) plus the arch synthesizer returned 19 structured findings successfully — same diff, same models, no parse failure. The architectural difference: local dispatch passes the diff file PATH (/tmp/dso-review-345/diff.patch) and lets the agent Read it; CI Strategy F inlines chunked diff content into the prompt.

### 4. Suspected Categories

* Token-budget exhaustion at model output — 134KB output suggests the model emitted long narrative / refusal text that mixed prose with JSON instead of the structured schema.
* Strategy F prompt may not constrain the model to JSON-only strongly enough when input chunk count is high.
* No JSON-parse-failure graceful degradation — when parse fails, the fallback exhausts and the job cancels with no partial findings emitted and no human-review tag applied.
* Region-split threshold may be set too low (Strategy F is the costly fallback; chunking earlier would be cheaper).
* review.large_diff.ignore.glob empty — WARNING line suggests an unused config knob that, if populated with defaults (snapshots, test fixtures, generated files), would shrink effective diff size enough to skip Strategy F.

### 5. Skills and Workflows Touched

* /dso:review (the deep-tier skill this CI job operationalises)
* plugins/dso/scripts/llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh
* plugins/dso/scripts/llm-review-runner.py (or equivalent runner)
* plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md (contract being violated)
* plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md (local-side equivalent that succeeded)

### 6. Logs and Evidence

* Full CI log: `gh run view 26415787344 --log --job 77762612379` (search "Strategy F" / "non-JSON")
* Local successful dispatch evidence: PR #345 finalize session — 4 deep-tier sub-agents returned 19 structured findings against the same diff.
* PR scale for repro: 99 files / +12,609 / -4,936 lines / ~18,600 diff lines. The threshold above which Strategy F activates can be derived from this scale point.

#### Suggested investigation entry points

* plugins/dso/scripts/ — locate the Strategy F dispatch and the JSON-parse fallback handler.
* review.large_diff.ignore.glob / review.large_diff.region_split.threshold config keys (the WARNING points at the first).
* Compare the CI Strategy F prompt template vs. the locally-successful agent prompts — local passes diff file path; CI inlines chunked content. Profile which yields more structured output under opus at scale.
